macros.name: changenotescontentsname
macros.doc: To change the name for the notes in the table of contents ( by default “Notes”) issue \changenotescontentsname{your version}.

macros.name: changenotesheader
macros.doc: To change the running header (by default “Notes to”) issue \changenotesheader{your version}.

macros.name: changenotesname
macros.doc: To change the name for the endnote section for notes (the default is Notes), issue \changenotesname{your version}.

macros.name: notesbychapter
macros.doc: resets the note counter every time you issue a \chapter command, and it puts a centered line reading “Chapter <chapter number > <chapter title>” in the notes at that point.

macros.name: notesincontents
macros.doc: To include a line for the endnotes in the table of contents, issue \notesincontents or (toggling the boolean) \notesincontentsontrue.

macros.name: notesincontentsonfalse
macros.doc: If you do not wish to include a line for the endnotes in the table of contents, issue \notesincontentsonfalse (This is the default).

macros.name: notesincontentsontrue
macros.doc: To include a line for the endnotes in the table of contents, issue \notesincontents or (toggling the boolean) \notesincontentsontrue.

macros.name: setupendnoteheaders
macros.doc: \setupendnoteheaders sets the first page of the notes section to the empty pagestyle, since you normally don’t have running headers on the first page of a section.

macros.name: titleinnotesfalse
macros.doc: If you want only the chapter number, not its title, issue \titleinnotesfalse in your preamble.
